coordinate_provenance.method: Scale-bar measurement on the official disaster-path reference figure 04_disaster_path_official.jpg (Institute of Geomechanics, CAGS / China Geological Survey; mirrored in-project at data/cases/jilong_20260826/satellite/04_disaster_path_official.jpg, original URL https://www.igm.cgs.gov.cn/mobile/kjdt/202609/W020260903364698987537.jpg). The figure places the high hanging-glacier source area approximately 10 km east of the Jilong Port marker along the documented ice-avalanche/debris-flow path; offset converted to degrees at latitude 28.28 (1 deg lon ~ 98.0 km) and added to the anchor coordinate.

static_susceptibility_inputs.description: Authorized static factor inputs inherited from the frozen Historical Replay six-factor model, EXCLUDING factor R5 (monsoon / high-precipitation background) to prevent double counting with dynamic weather. G03A stores inputs and weights only; the deterministic Regional Static Susceptibility Baseline B is computed by G03B, never here.
static_susceptibility_inputs.derived_from: MountainGuardian Jilong Case Pack v0.1 demo_risk_model.factors (frozen), minus R5

excluded_factors.name: Monsoon and high-precipitation background
excluded_factors.reason: Excluded from the Risk Watch static baseline to avoid double counting with the dynamic precipitation trigger.

static_susceptibility_inputs.normalization: Retained original relative weights renormalized to 100% (divide by 90, multiply by 100).

factors.name: Huge vertical drop and narrow gorge

static_susceptibility_inputs.derivation_boundary: No B / R / F / D / C / O7 value is stored or computed in G03A. G03B recomputes B deterministically from these inputs.

weather_data_policy.operational_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API, model ecmwf_ifs (ECMWF IFS), https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast
weather_data_policy.historical_source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather (Archive) API, https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive. Frozen preference: era5_land. Verified 2026-10-01 against current official docs and live API: ERA5-Land exposes no precipitation variable (nulls), so precipitation climatology uses the consistent single-model era5 reanalysis on the same endpoint/period when the preferred model returns no precipitation; the fallback is validated at retrieval time and recorded in each climatology reference provenance. Mixed 'best match' series are prohibited.

provenance.separation_statement: This file is the independent Risk Watch Source of Truth. It contains only information legitimately usable for continuing monitoring. It intentionally excludes all Historical Replay post-event validation content (trigger confirmation, disaster chain, runout, travel time, speed, affected area, destroyed structures, post-event satellite validation, later-report fracture time).
provenance.coordinate_policy: No monitoring-point coordinate is invented. Every coordinate record carries its source reference, meaning and exact/representative classification.

scientific_limitations: Open-Meteo ECMWF / ERA5-Land values are gridded model and reanalysis products, not local automatic stations or source-zone sensors; complex terrain and microclimate are only partly represented.
No public real-time source-zone displacement, crack, microseismic or ice-avalanche precursor monitoring exists; this configuration must not be read as supporting exact collapse-time prediction.
Monitoring-point coordinates are representative grid anchors (derived/representative, with stated uncertainty), not surveyed instrument locations.
Percentile positions describe meteorological anomaly relative to the 1991-2020 local climatology; they are not disaster probabilities.
